Hi,

I saw the Junior Graphic Designer opening for Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters and Craft Bakehouse and wanted to connect, as your focus on craft innovation and the specialty coffee value chain stands out to me.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives, building reusable visual systems in Illustrator and Photoshop that cut turnaround time for corporate communications.

My work on the branding kit for AT Creation demonstrates foundational visual identity and brand guideline development, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur, ready to relocate to Mumbai, and would love to share a quick look at my branding work if you have a moment.

Ananya

I saw your opening for a UI/UX Designer at Codeft Digital, and I was drawn to the chance to work directly with engineers on early-stage product development without heavy process.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates research-backed interface design and clean user flows at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I would appreciate a fifteen-minute call to walk through my wireframing and prototyping process. I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Hyderabad.
